lines.text: The LORD asks Satan where he has come from, and Satan answers that he has been roaming through the earth.
Satan asks the LORD to strike Job's flesh and bones, and the LORD puts Job in his hands but tells him to spare Job's life.
Satan infects Job with terrible boils, and Job sits among the thorns scraping himself with a piece of broken pottery.
Job's wife tells him to curse God and die, and Job's three friends Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar come to comfort him.
The friends weep aloud and tear their robes, then sit on the ground with Job for ten days and ten nights without speaking.
